about: R123 (HCFC-123) is a low-pressure refrigerant used in centrifugal chillers, mainly in large commercial air-conditioning plants. Its ozone-depletion and global-warming potentials are low compared with many refrigerants, but it is more toxic than most, so leak detection and ventilation in plant rooms matter.
Handling should be done by trained technicians using recovery equipment.

faq.question: Is R123 (Dichlorotrifluoroethane) flammable?
faq.answer: R123 (Dichlorotrifluoroethane) is classified as non-flammable, but it is stored under pressure and can displace oxygen in enclosed spaces. Handle it through a trained technician with proper gauges, recovery equipment and ventilation.
